notes.title: Sail Forth is out now!
notes.content:
We're so excited to announce that Sail Forth is OUT NOW on Steam!

Master semi-realistic sailing physics to chart unknown waters in a heartfelt journey to save the world! Put the wind to your back and cast out into a vast ocean spanning dozens of eccentric regions. Discover countless isles bursting with their own flora, fauna, friendly folk, and fearsome foes. Playfully pursue a pod of curious dolphins, admire the beauty of the sun sinking into an icy horizon, or run down a clutch of cowardly criminals only to accept their apologies to the tune of wild cannonry. Will you answer the call of High Adventure?

Get it for 10% off now through December 28!

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35031246/3ebc5b48aa645af5f7136bf7906f484f0a7f9c07.gif[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1031460/Sail_Forth/

notes.title: Freshly Frosted is in the Tiny Teams festival!
notes.content:
We're so excited to be a part of the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/yogscastgames/sale/tinyteamsfestival]Tiny Teams festival[/url] this year! As a tiny team of 3 people, we've been blown away by the reception to our adorable donut game. 

The Tiny Teams festival takes place August 1-8 and features a bunch of demos, discounts, and streams of games made by small teams. You can check out the Tiny Teams team play Freshly Frosted on stream on [b]Tuesday, August 2nd[/b] between 2-5 PM BST (6-9 AM PDT) at twitch.tv/yogscast!

Thank you so much for all your support! We'll have more Freshly Frosted news soon. <3

notes.title: Freshly Frosted has full CORSAIR iCUE integration!
notes.content:
Visuals are an important part of the experience of Freshly Frosted, and we're excited to partner with CORSAIR to provide full [url=https://www.corsair.com/us/en/icue]RGB iCUE integration[/url]! If you use any iCUE enabled gaming accessories, you'll be immersed in a beautifully lit world with carefully curated profiles to match the sweet pastel colors of the game.

Check it out now!

notes.title: Freshly Frosted is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

We're SO excited to say that Freshly Frosted is out now!! We've put so much love into this game and we hope you enjoy your time playing it. Get it now through June 17th for a 10% discount!

If you have the time, we'd love to see your reviews on Steam! We're a small team and we want to hear your feedback.

Be sure to check out the [url=https://wholesomegames.com/]Wholesome Direct[/url] showcase on June 11 to see more Freshly Frosted content!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34922346/710c68ce47c55e071f80bd93b4b1ebee04d428b8.gif[/img]

notes.title: Freshly Frosted is launching this Friday, June 10th!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

I'm really excited to let you all know that Freshly Frosted is launching this Friday, June 10th, at midnight PDT!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34922346/710c68ce47c55e071f80bd93b4b1ebee04d428b8.gif[/img]

Freshly Frosted started as a game jam game in 2019 on Train Jam and since then it has grown into a beautiful and chill puzzle game. We've been working hard to get it ready for you and we're so excited to release it soon! 

If you know me, you know I love making puzzle games. I've poured a lot of love into the 144 puzzles in Freshly Frosted and I hope you take the time to check it out.

-Ty

notes.title: We've finished all the puzzles!
notes.content:
We've been working hard to get Freshly Frosted buttoned up and polished for release (soon 👀) and I'm very excited to say that all 144 puzzles are now complete! 

When I first started designing puzzles, I knew I wanted there to be a dozen dozen to fit with the donut theme. Designing 144 unique puzzles with different mechanics is no small task! But over the past two years I've been refining and testing the puzzles to make sure they're not [i]too[/i] hard and that there is a gradual progression of difficulty through each of the 12 boxes. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Ee4c5aZ.gif[/img]

I know you're gonna love working your way through each of the puzzles and seeing the fun different donut shapes and mechanics we've lovingly crafted. You won't have to wait long for more news about Freshly Frosted!

notes.title: Try a brand new Freshly Frosted demo for SIX 2021!
notes.content:
To celebrate the first weekend of the Seattle Indies Expo, we've released a brand new demo of Freshly Frosted that you can try right now to get a taste of this sugary, puzzley goodness! Freshly Frosted was a 2019 and 2020 SIX nominee and we're excited to be celebrating with them virtually this year!

You can check out all the nominees from 2020 and 2021 on sale on Steam here:
https://store.steampowered.com/sale/six2021

The SIX event starts on their Twitch channel https://www.twitch.tv/SeattleIndies September 11th at 11:00 am PDT and runs every Saturday in September from 11:00 am to 5:00 pm PDT. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34922346/799789934e30a042526812a9bce95b28d310ca5c.png[/img]

Congratulations to all of the 2021 nominees!

notes.title: Freshly Frosted Needs You!
notes.content:
Freshly Frosted Needs You!

Freshly Frosted has made it to the finals of AT&T Unlocked Games, a showcase spotlighting women leading the development of indie games! As you might already know, Freshly Frosted is a title we’re developing entirely in-house. Relax with the beautiful pastel colors and delightful donuts, all while enjoying an upbeat soundtrack. 

We’ve been working on this for years, and we’ve recently added new donut shapes, audio, and dozens of new levels; we can’t wait for you to see them. Starting today, there will be a demo for Freshly Frosted available for the next 24 hours - it’s got all kinds of neat new features so don’t miss it!

[url=https://www.qag.io/ffvote][img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1660103217220896614/0F448261BABD01B2F9079E373526152E42B1313C/[/img][/url]

We’ve got a lot of perfect little pastries we’d like to show you live on stream today at 6PM PST on the AT&T Unlocked Games stream at http://twitch.tv/eleagueTV. The AT&T Unlocked Games showcase is going to be hosted by Annemunition and Bnans, two incredibly successful streamers from Twitch! You’ll be able to see more from Freshly Frosted during this stream, and that’s followed by a 24 hour voting period where you can win a lifetime supply of high fives by voting for us as Gamers Choice!

HERE’S HOW YOU CAN HELP US WIN!

[list]
[*][url=qag.io/ffvote]Vote for Freshly Frosted for Gamers Choice between today at 6PM PST and tomorrow at 6PM PST here![/url]
[/list] 

One of the reasons we’re so excited about being included in this contest is because we’ll have a shot at securing more funding for Freshly Frosted by winning the Gamers Choice award! Winning means we would have more to work with to make the game great, and we’d love to show the game off to even more people. We’re counting on you to pick us so that we can deliver the best little donut factory that there’s ever been

Now get out there and vote!

[url=https://www.qag.io/ffvote][img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1660103217220906483/680AAD972BB868D029D34B9767410F38B6245EC7/[/img][/url]
